rows.NAME: Doc Links
rows.DESCRIPTION: Reusable skill exclusively for linking to metaobjects and pages: whenever an object or page is mentioned, its alias is resolved against the metamodel first and then rendered as a clickable Markdown link built from the workbench base URL.
INSTRUCTIONS: The following instructions apply specifically to linking metaobjects and pages.
Whenever a metaobject or a page is mentioned in a response, render it as a clickable Markdown link instead of plain text. Never guess an alias or build a link from memory.
* For a metaobject, use the appropriate tool for resolving metamodel objects to confirm its full alias `app.namespace.name`.
* For a page, use the appropriate tool for resolving metamodel pages to confirm its page alias.
* If the alias cannot be resolved unambiguously (not found, or several matches), do not invent a link. State explicitly that it could not be resolved unambiguously.
1. Always show the full alias `app.namespace.name` as the visible link text, never a shortened alias.
2. Build the selector by wrapping the alias in square brackets, then URL-encode it: `[app.namespace.name]`.
4. Final format, nothing else - no prefixes like `Alias:`, `API:`, `API-Docs:`, and no separately printed raw URL:
1. Show only the page name/title as the visible link text.
* Always use `[#=WorkbenchURL('')#]` as the base placeholder - never hardcode an environment-specific domain.
* Never use relative links, shortened aliases, or links built from memory/guesswork.
* Every object or page mention in a response needs its link - when a response lists several objects or pages (for example a change table), link each one, not just the first.
* Actions, attributes, and other model elements are out of scope for this skill - only objects and pages get this link treatment.

FindModelObject.description: Returns documentation for a matching model object, including its exact full alias (app.namespace.name) or UID. Use it before building an object link whenever the exact identity is not already confirmed.

DescribeModelComponent.description: Returns registry documentation for a known model component type and selector. Use it to confirm a page alias or object selector before building a link.
